summary: First-run end-to-end test of the Agentic AI Recruitment Pipeline MVP. Executed 30 backend pytest tests (all passing) plus Playwright UI coverage of all 15 flows in the review request. Every acceptance criterion (persona scoping, PM denial, evaluation with real LLM + idempotency, approval gate + role warning, scheduling with skill-matched interviewer, SLA sweep + idempotent second run, invite accept idempotency, feedback + AI transcript summary, agent A2A card, orchestrator SSE chat scoped to persona, chat history persistence across reload, comms outbox, scoped reports + idempotent daily digest, CSV upsert imports) passes.

issues: The selected agent tile in the top grid shares the same data-testid as the outer card (agent-card-<key>), so querying agent-card-* returns 7 elements for 6 agents. Cosmetic only – functionality unaffected; would only matter for stricter length assertions.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~790 lines — consider splitting into routers (positions.py, approvals.py, agents.py, imports.py) once it grows further; currently readable but at the edge of the recommended size.

current_user() falls back to the first DM when X-User-Id is missing/invalid — great for the demo, but should be tightened to 401 before productionising (documented behaviour per PRD, so not blocking).

match_interviewer scoring uses raw counts; interviewers with 0 skill overlap can still be selected when no better candidate exists. Acceptable per spec but worth surfacing in the match_reason (currently already does).

chat streaming endpoint opens two DB sessions (one sync before yield, one inside gen()). Works fine, but the second session holds a connection for the full LLM stream duration — could pool-starve under load.
Positions CSV importer treats missing `status` column by defaulting to OPEN; there is no validation that the value is one of the pipeline enum values (could silently import an invalid state).

Frontend uses window.localStorage as the source of truth for persona in api.js interceptor AND in PersonaContext state — both are kept in sync in the codebase today, but any future path that bypasses PersonaContext.setPersona would drift.
test_credentials: No credentials required (persona switcher via X-User-Id header). Personas: Diana (dm), Priya Nair (pm Phoenix), Pablo Ortiz (pm Atlas), Sam Whitfield (staffing).
seed_data_creation: Test file created two rows that persist in the seeded DB: POS-TEST-1 (project TestProjX) via backend pytest and POS-TEST-UI-1 (project TestProjUI) via UI import test. Also inserted interviewer test_ivy@delivery.demo. These do not affect scoped views for the four seeded personas (assigned to non-seeded projects, DM sees them via account-wide scope).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pipeline state has been advanced during this run: POS-101 EVALUATING→PENDING_PM_APPROVAL (evaluation cached; re-run returns reused=True). POS-102 approved by Priya, scheduled 2 interviews (Arjun Iyer/Node.js matched), status INTERVIEW_INVITE_SENT with pending invites (Grace Okoye, Priyanka Shah). POS-103 invite accepted → INTERVIEW_ACCEPTED (Yuki Tanaka). POS-104 feedback pass submitted for Viktor Hansen → FEEDBACK_RECEIVED with real AI transcript summary. Two extra positions (POS-TEST-1, POS-TEST-UI-1) exist from CSV upsert tests. Daily report digest already distributed today so /api/reports/send now returns already_sent_today=true until midnight UTC.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Only observation: the agent-card-* testid is applied both to the tile in the top grid and (in the selection state) also picked up when the outer wrapper renders; this is a cosmetic testability concern, not a functional bug. Suggest either using agent-tile-<key> for the grid + agent-detail-<key> for the selected panel, or asserting on unique parent selectors in future tests.
